reranked_evidence.title: Shiva - Wikipedia
reranked_evidence.snippet: # Shiva. | God of Destruction * God of Time, Yoga, Meditation and Arts * Lord of Yogis and Physicians * The Cosmic Dancer The Supreme Being (Shaivism) | |. 'The Remover'), is one of the principal deities of Hinduism. He is the Supreme Being in Shaivism, one of the major traditions within Hinduism. Shiva is one of the five equivalent deities in Panchayatana puja of the Smarta tradition of Hinduism. Shiva is known as *The Destroyer* within the Trimurti, the Hindu trinity which also includes Brahma and Vishnu. In benevolent aspects, he is depicted as an omniscient yogi who lives an ascetic life on Kailasa as well as a householder with his wife Parvati and his two children, Ganesha and Kartikeya. The Sanskrit word **śaiva** means "relating to the god Shiva", and this term is the Sanskrit name both for one of the principal sects of Hinduism and for a member of that sect.
